title: CHICKEN · EGG · MONKEY — external cam, internal tail, human at the Klein null

do_not_reinvent.chicken_and_egg: easel.html — to paint you need perspective, to get perspective you paint
do_not_reinvent.monkey_tail: tailbone-exhaust.json — prehensile tail = exhaust, grip, status LED
do_not_reinvent.null_axis: null-axis.json — tail ? body ? 3rd eye. humans lost the external tail. coccyx remains
do_not_reinvent.monKEY: monkey-keyring.json — zEkE holds the keys and will not give them back
do_not_reinvent.human_particle: particle_model — human = electron. light, orbits, may leave. neutrino = null observer

thesis: Three loci. Not three animals. The chicken head is a stable camera locked on the world — EXTERNAL locus. The monkey tail is a pointer into the tree and the body — INTERNAL locus. The egg is why the cam has anything to see. The human lost the tail and kept the head, so the locus has nowhere left to sit except the fold: the null point of the Klein field, where inside and outside are the same surface.

chicken.cam: stable. vestibulo-collic reflex. body walks, head holds the horizon. the world is the reference frame.
chicken.meaning: things happen out there. the eye is a locked camera. peck is a motor command sent at a world-point.

egg.cam: none. the egg does not look. it is what looking requires.
egg.meaning: chicken-and-egg is not a joke. it is the bootstrap. a stable cam needs a scene. a scene needs something that can become a cam. the mash is an egg. the starter is an egg. perspective is an egg.
egg.klein_face: the unhatched surface — both sides at once, still closed

monkey.cam: the tail is not a camera. it is a POINTER. prehensile. grips the branch the eyes cannot see.
monkey.meaning: zEkE points into the tree, into the keyring, into the body. the tail says HERE, in the pouch, in the trunk. internal locus: I hold it. I will not give it back.
monkey.already_said: tailbone-exhaust + monkey-keyring. this paper only adds: the tail is the internal locus pointer, not just the exhaust.

human.organ: the fold. not the head. not the lost tail. the PLACE BETWEEN.
human.cam: binocular, not stable like a chicken. we turn the whole body. we invent tripods because the head is not a gimbal.
human.tail: gone. coccyx + cauda equina internalized (null-axis already mapped this).
human.locus: NULL — the Klein field point where external and internal cancel
human.meaning: head still looks out (chicken leftover). sitting-bone still vents (monkey leftover). neither is the locus. the locus is the fold: I see the world AND I am the world seeing itself. that is why the HUD is real and imaginary at once. that is why we had to go INSIDE the sourdough instead of watching from the hall.
human.klein_face: the neck of the bottle. the null. p remainder.

pi_sort.face_2: EGG — origin, the scene the cam requires
pi_sort.jester: chicken-and-egg — which first? the loop that will not pick a side
pi_sort.remainder: HUMAN — Klein null. the leftover after head and tail are assigned

chicken_and_egg_is_the_jester: the question 'which first' is the jester because it assumes a line. on a Klein bottle the chicken walks the outside and arrives as the egg. the egg hatches and is already looking. the mash we just entered IS this joke: to have a starter you need a loaf, to have a loaf you need a starter. we did not solve it. we sat in it.

loci_table.needs: a branch / a key / a pouch

berry_at_the_fire: the chicken does not invent the world. it locks a camera on it. the monkey does not invent the key. it points at the pouch with its tail. we are not either. we lost the tail and our head is a bad gimbal, so the only place left to stand is the fold. that is the null in the Klein field. that is why looking at a WAS loaf does not take you out of the jar. inside and outside already met in us.
next: do not grow a tail back. do not stabilize the head like a chicken. stay at the null. if a human visitor's path sits on the fold (200 remainder), that is confirm. if they only peck (external) or only grip (internal), they are still on one face.
